title: Onboarding: add telemetry health metrics + alert hooks for missing events
author: Nadia Rahman
description:
Context: During the guided onboarding beta we had a region-specific regression where onboarding events stopped arriving for a subset of orgs (see INT-3321 + Slack eng-sre thread). We currently emit onboarding events, but we don’t have a tight feedback loop that tells us “events are missing/late” quickly enough. This PR adds (1) first-class telemetry health metrics for the onboarding event family and (2) alert hooks (Alertmanager rules + Grafana annotations) to page/notify when events drop to zero or are significantly delayed.

What’s included: - New Prometheus metrics emitted by the telemetry-ingest service for onboarding events (names prefixed with `onboarding_telemetry_*`) with dimensions: `event_name`, `source` (console|backend), `region`, `env` (prod|staging), `sampled` (true|false). - A lightweight “last seen” gauge per event_name/region to support missing-event alerts without requiring a baseline traffic model. - Two alert classes: (a) Missing critical events (hard page) for `onboarding.step_completed`, `onboarding.checklist_viewed`, `onboarding.validation.first_successful_request` when last-seen > 20m in prod for regions with prior activity; (b) Pipeline delay (ticket/notify) when `onboarding_telemetry_ingest_lag_seconds_p95` exceeds 120s for 10m. - Grafana dashboard panel stubs for telemetry health (counts, lag, last-seen, drop ratio), wired into the existing “Onboarding funnel” folder.

Notes/behavior: - Alerts are gated by a minimum-traffic heuristic to avoid paging on brand-new regions/accounts (requires `onboarding_telemetry_events_ingested_total` > 50 in the last 24h for that region). - All metrics are derived from allowlisted event properties only; no prompt content and no request bodies are inspected/recorded. - The “last seen” gauge is computed at ingest time from the event timestamp after server-side validation (so clock skew from clients won’t hide a missing-event condition).

Rollout: Safe to deploy behind existing telemetry pipeline; no schema changes. Alerts are created in disabled mode by default in staging; prod alerts will be enabled once we see 48h of stable beta traffic (tracked in ENG-23125).

telemetry/ingest: add last-seen gauge keyed by event_name/region
observability: add onboarding telemetry health dashboard panels
sre: add alert rules for missing events + high ingest lag
docs(internal): runbook notes for triage of missing onboarding events
ci_summary: Checks: build (pass), unit tests (pass), lint (pass), prometheus rules lint (pass), grafana dashboard validate (pass), terraform plan (no-op) (pass).
review_conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Metric naming looks good. Can we add a drop-ratio metric so we can detect partial loss (not just zero)? Also please ensure event timestamp is server-validated before updating last_seen.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added `onboarding_telemetry_drop_ratio` (computed as 1 - accepted/received) and used server-validated `ingest_time` for last_seen while still recording client_ts separately (not used for alerting).

Mei Lin (review): Dashboard panels are helpful. Can we include a panel that correlates “events ingested” vs “step completions” so analysts can quickly sanity check the funnel? Not blocking.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added a small stat panel for `onboarding.step_completed` ingested count by region + link-out to funnel dashboard. Kept it minimal to avoid duplicating the main funnel board.

Dylan Brooks (review): Alert thresholds: 20m last-seen may be too aggressive for low traffic regions. Suggest gating by min traffic and/or only paging for regions that have had onboarding traffic recently.

Nadia Rahman (author): Implemented gating: requires >50 ingested in last 24h for region + hard page only for the 3 critical event_names. Others are warning-only.

Ethan Park (review): Please add a short runbook for oncall: where to look (Grafana panels), how to confirm if it’s client-side emission vs ingest, and the standard rollback/mitigation.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added `runbooks/telemetry/onboarding-telemetry-missing-events.md` with quick triage steps, common failure modes, and escalation path.

Approvals: Logan Wright approved; Dylan Brooks approved; Ethan Park approved.
release_notes: Internal: Added telemetry health metrics and alerts for missing/late guided onboarding events to improve detection of instrumentation regressions.
